description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named CacheController that manages cache operations such as displaying cache keys and clearing cache entries in an admin interface for a web application.

classes.name: CacheController
classes.description: A Spring Controller managing cache-related endpoints such as displaying cache keys and clearing cache entries.

methods.name: displayAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display cache keys for a given merchant store.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Handles POST requests to clear a specific cache entry or all cache entries for a merchant store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for rendering the admin UI, highlighting the cache menu.
